entries.label: Dynamics as Usual
entries.quote: Dynamics as Usual is a world where social priorities for ‘clean’, ‘secure’ and, ultimately, ‘sustainable’ energy shape the system.
entries.subject: energy system

entries.label: The Spirit of the Coming Age
entries.quote: In The Spirit of the Coming Age superior ways of meeting energy needs are developed to meet consumer preferences.

entries.metric: natural gas imports as share of total energy consumption, EU
entries.quote: Natural gas imports grow significantly by 2020 – from 7% to 20% of total energy consumption in the EU, from 9% to 16% in Japan, and from 1% to 3% in North East Asia.

entries.subject: natural gas
entries.metric: gas overtakes coal in primary energy
entries.quote: By 2010 gas has truly overtaken coal and by 2020 it is challenging oil as the dominant source of primary energy.
entries.note: Qualitative milestone (2010: gas above coal; 2020: gas challenging oil).

entries.subject: renewable energy
entries.metric: renewables share of global primary energy
entries.quote: By 2020 a wide variety of renewable sources is supplying a fifth of electricity in many OECD markets and nearly a tenth of global primary energy.
entries.note: "Nearly a tenth"; value is an upper bound.

entries.scenario: The Spirit of the Coming Age
entries.subject: fuel cells
entries.quote: After extraordinary cost reductions for PEM fuel cells over the past decade, manufacturing scale brings costs below $500 per kW by 2006 and $50 per kW shortly after 2010, to be directly competitive with internal combustion engines.
